name: Yama

mechanics.name: Standard Attacks
mechanics.description: He swings his axe at anything within three tiles, and at range he snaps his fingers after either flames or shadow swirls gather on you, which is the only tell for which style is coming.
mechanics.counterplay: Watch what gathers before the snap and pray accordingly. Protect from Melee cuts the axe to almost nothing.

mechanics.name: Shadow Waves
mechanics.description: Waves of shadowy flame roll in from the edges of the arena and sweep across it.
mechanics.counterplay: Jump each wave as it reaches you. Getting clipped turns your overhead prayer off.

mechanics.name: Fire Streaks
mechanics.description: Fires light along the arena edge and run across it at the speed you do.
mechanics.counterplay: Run straight through without stopping. Pausing inside one binds you in place.

mechanics.name: Void Flares
mechanics.description: Demonic orbs appear with a bar filling above them. If one fills it explodes hard and gives Yama health back.
mechanics.counterplay: Break them before the bar fills. Magic does it fastest.

mechanics.name: Judge of Yama
mechanics.description: At two health thresholds he sends you away to fight his Judge across a field of lava stones. The Judge throws fire and swaps its defences to whatever you are attacking with.
mechanics.counterplay: Bring water spells and stay on magic. The Judge is the gate, not an optional fight.

mechanics.name: Meteor Strike
mechanics.description: A meteor comes down on a target with a wide blast around where it lands.
mechanics.counterplay: Get two tiles clear of the marker. One tile still hurts, and the centre kills.

mechanics.name: Shadow Stomp
mechanics.description: He stomps the ground and roots everyone caught by it, draining prayer as it lands.
mechanics.counterplay: Stay out of the stomp. Being rooted with no prayer is what turns this into a death.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc ids 14176, 15555 and 15700 are the boss, all carrying models [10468, 10338, 10340] and standing animation 12140. Several other npcs share the name and are excluded: YAMA_THRONE 123 and YAMA_THRONE_OCCUPIED 124 are furniture, 15645 and 14157 are the throne scene, and the Voice and Disciple npcs are dialogue. The Judge is AKD_JUDGE_OF_YAMA_COMBAT 10938 with 14180 and 15663; all three are curated as npc-spawn triggers because it is not established which the fight uses. Animations are the NPC_YAMA01_* set, all unambiguous gameval names: IDLE 12140, MAGIC01 12144, MAGIC02 12145, MELEE01 12146, PORTAL01 12147 and STOMP01 12148. THE TWO MAGIC SEQUENCES ARE CURATED AS ONE MECHANIC covering both fire and shadow, because the wiki describes them as the same move differing only in which effect gathers on you, and the cache offers no way to tell which sequence is which. Projectiles VFX_PROJ_YAMA_FIRE_SKULL_01 12102, VFX_YAMA_FLAMING_ROCK_PROJECTILE_01 12105 and VFX_YAMA_SHADOW_SPIKE_PROJECTILE_01 12108 are curated because each says projectile outright in Jagex's own name; the matching SPOTANIM and IMPACT ids (12095 through 12101, 12104, 12106, 12107, 12109, 12110) are graphics and are left out, since a graphic trigger has no source actor to check (docs/DECISIONS.md D17) and discovery never revokes (D18). The whole fight is laid out under a YAMA_ prefix in the gamevals, which is what gives three of these mechanics exact npc triggers: YAMA_VOIDFLARE 14179 is the flare, YAMA_METEOR_NPC 14182 is what the stomp drops, and YAMA_JUDGE_OF_YAMA 14180 is the Judge. YAMA_IMP 14181 exists and is deliberately not curated, because the wiki's mechanic list has nothing matching it. THE GLYPH MECHANIC DETECTS ON PORTAL01 12147, which is an inference: the glyphs are ground markers rather than anything the boss animates, and the portal sequence is the closest thing in his set. It is the weakest trigger in this file. THIS BOSS'S ANIMATIONS ARE SKELETAL, SO THE PREVIEW VALUES ARE AN ESTIMATE, NOT ARITHMETIC (docs/DECISIONS.md D36). FitZoom returned empty extents for all three sequences tried. The values follow the method Doom of Mokhaiotl already ships under: take the zoom from struct 4737, the Combat Achievements screen's own entry, which pins model 10339 at zoom 2500, and compute shiftY from the bind pose extents at that zoom. THE PREVIEW PINS modelId 10339 RATHER THAN RESOLVING THROUGH npcId, and here that is not merely preferable but necessary: 10339 is not in the npc's model list at all (which holds 10468, 10338 and 10340), so it is a merged model built for the CA screen, exactly the case that produced the half-rendered General Graardor fixed in issue #89. The Judge preview resolves through npcId and borrows the generic DEMON_UPDATE_* set the way Skotizo does. staticFallback is false on all six; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game, and for a skeletal boss that check matters more than usual. The collection log page is titled 'Yama', matching 'name'. REDO 2026-08-07 (Andrew asked for a full list rewrite): The list is now the seven rows Andrew specified. THIS PASS FIXED A REAL BUG: the old Stomp row detected on npc-spawn 14182, which the gamevals name YAMA_METEOR_NPC. It was firing on the meteor, not the stomp. Meteor Strike now owns 14182 and Shadow Stomp owns NPC_YAMA01_STOMP01 12148, which is what it should always have been. CONFIDENT IDS: void flares YAMA_VOIDFLARE 14179, the Judge 14180 plus its league and quest variants, the meteor npc 14182, the stomp 12148, and standard attacks MAGIC01/MAGIC02/MELEE01 12144/12145/12146. SHADOW WAVES AND FIRE STREAKS ARE INFERRED: both are arena hazards that come from locs rather than npcs, so neither has an animation to detect, and they are curated as graphic triggers on the Yama-specific spotanims VFX_YAMA_SHADOW_SPIKE 3256/3258 and VFX_YAMA_FLAMING_ROCK 3253/3255. Graphics gate on boss presence only (docs/DECISIONS.md D17), which is acceptable here because these ids are Yama-specific and a player cannot produce them, but the mapping from the wiki names to these gameval names is a judgement call. The old Glyphs row is gone; it was not in Andrew's list.
